programs.title: Brahmachari
programs.desc: Abandoned as a child, Brahmachari lives in a mortgaged house with twelve young orphans  he saves a woman from dying and she changes his life forever  but first she has to deal with her own affairs.

programs.title: Hasina Maan Jayegi
programs.desc: Rakesh and Kamal, doppelgangers of one another, fall for the same woman, Archana. However, when their petty rivalry evolves into something more sinister, she must find her true love.

programs.title: Choron Ki Baarat
programs.desc: Anju falls in love with Shekhar and offers him employment under her father. Even though he readily accepts it, she later finds out the real motive behind his actions.
